value.strategy: The Sub-Fund is positioned to withstand a broad range of different environments, and our approach is always to remain patient and lean into risk when we are rewarded to do so. We remain conservatively positioned, with a relatively low weighting to equities and significant exposure to more defensive assets in the form of gold, short-dated inflation-linked bonds, and liquidity. Nevertheless, we are also poised to act as and when opportunities arise, and will become more aggressive in increasing equity exposure if the current dislocation intensifies.
value.philosophy: Our approach is always to remain patient and lean into risk when we are rewarded to do so. The Strategy has greatly benefited from opportunistically buying from those indiscriminately selling in the past and should continue to do so in future.
value.selection_process: We add to existing holdings and establish new holdings when equity markets have fallen. We exit positions because of uncertainties about future growth in earnings, and the risk to current valuations. We manage the weighting of precious metals within the portfolio. We reduce weighted average duration to bonds and trim net US dollar exposure, adding Japanese Government Bonds with a maturity of less than two years when the yen is cheap relative to sterling and should benefit in a risk off environment. We seek companies with commanding market shares, strong competitive positions, high profitability, durable and consistent financial metrics, long-term growth potential, strong product innovation, consistent investment in R&D, family ownership for long-term decisions, essential infrastructure, high-quality franchises, impossible-to-replicate assets, and pricing power.
value.asset_types: Equities (e.g., Agilent Technologies, Alphabet, Chubb, Diageo, Adobe, L’Oréal, Hubbell, Canadian National Railway, LSEG, LVMH), gold, short-dated inflation-linked bonds, liquidity, and Japanese Government Bonds.
value.real_objectives: Fulfilling our dual mandate of preserving our investors’ capital and growing it in real terms over the long term.
